[[WP:EXPLICITGENRE]] says "explicitly attribute the genre to the work or artist as a whole." That means that for a genre to be applied to a work, the genre must be explicitly attributed to the work. And for a genre to be applied to an artist, that genre must be explicitly applied to the artist. It does not mean that if a genre has been applied to any amount of the artist's work, that it can then be applied to the artist without additional sourcing.
